elastic_mlip_600K_GPa_v2.v1_v2_interpretation: Anneal champion +21% stiffer (E_VRH 28.6 -> 34.7, +6.1 GPa). Br ordering improvement strengthens 600K thermal averaged elastic response.

bader_charge_v2.v1_v2_interpretation: Anneal -> Br more ionic (|q|: 0.840->0.891, +6.1%), Cl slightly less (0.925->0.910). Br/Cl ionicity gap narrows. P measured for first time in v2: +4.893.
bader_charge_v2.notes: NEW finding: comp2 v2 P=+4.893 > comp1 v2 P=+4.686 (delta +0.207e, +4.4%). Br doping STRENGTHENS PS4 covalent backbone (anti-trend to Cl ionicity weakening). Br has dual effect: ionic (Cl |q| down) AND covalent (P |q| up). Vacancy effect (modelC v2 P=+4.340) is opposite sign.
